svg.title: How far the analyst may reach, and what it is sent
svg.desc: analyst.reach sets how far a request may go: local allows loopback only, lan also allows private and link-local IP addresses, remote allows any host. Plain http is allowed to loopback, and to a LAN address only without a key; everything else needs https. The key is read from the environment variable named by api_key_env when the service starts and is never stored. From the dashboard, a request is sent only after you confirm an estimate of its destination, whether it leaves the machine, its size and its number of requests; the answer is plain text, shown as advice. Local AI agents using the agent API skip that confirmation.
svg.text: THE ANALYST: REACH AND CONSENT
analyst.reach bounds where a request may go; the estimate-and-confirm step decides whether it goes at all.
REMOTE
any host, https only · e.g. a hosted API
reach = "remote"
LAN
private or link-local IP addresses (never a name)
http only without a key; https with one
reach = "lan"
LOCAL · THE DEFAULT
loopback only: nothing leaves the machine
reach = "local"
Examples
A local vLLM or llama.cpp server:
Ollama:
Both with provider = "openai-compatible";
NeonWatch posts to {base_url}/chat/completions.
A GPU box on your network, keyless:
Anthropic: provider = "anthropic", base_url empty, reach = "remote", and a key.
The key never enters the config
api_key_env names an environment variable, such as
api_key_env = "ANTHROPIC_API_KEY"
The service reads it when it starts. Unset, the analyst
is simply off. The key is never stored or logged.
From the dashboard, every time
You pick issues, a time window, log lines or services,
and may add a question.
NeonWatch shows an estimate, before anything is sent:
· the destination host, and whether it leaves this machine
· characters to send (each request at most max_input_chars)
· how many requests
You press Send. The requests go as estimated,
redacted again, each with a timeout of timeout_s.
The answer comes back as plain text, up to
max_output_tokens, labelled LLM · ADVISORY. Its
suggested checks are for you to copy, never run.
Local AI agents skip steps 2 and 3
Anything holding the agent token can start analyst jobs
directly. Each is rate-limited and audited.
Reasoning models
A reasoning model left at its own default can spend the
whole token budget thinking. Set, for openai-compatible:
reasoning_effort = "low"
